about: One row per body and per clip family that the page loads at runtime from opentrident.org (data/clips.json `base`; never copied into this repo). `prefix` is a path under the base; the longest matching prefix covers a file. `license` is what is known: 'unconfirmed' means nobody has verified the redistribution terms and none is invented here; the OpenTrident dev owns confirming it (Strategy/PM queue item 2, 26 Oct). test/sources.test.mjs fails when a file data/clips.json loads has no row.
